goal: Sign on, find the member by member number (parameter member_number), open their record and click Funds Transfer. Fill the form from parameters from_share, to_share, amount and memo, continue to the CONFIRM FUNDS TRANSFER review screen, then post it. Report the confirmation number and the posted amount. IMPORTANT: before emitting, deliberately trigger a rejected transaction so you can read the app's real wording — member 100234 has share 100234-S0001 on HOLD, and transferring from it is refused. Declare flow-level business outcomes for (a) no matching member, and (b) a rejected transaction, detecting the generic rejection banner the review screen shows for any invalid transaction with a detail locator pointing at the specific reason line inside it, so insufficient funds and a held share both classify correctly and the caller still learns which happened.
